message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Okay, I have both calendars now. Let me cross-reference the times Brad sent me.

Brad's proposed times:
*   Mon: 11:00, 11:30
    *   Priya's availability: 11:00 is busy. 11:30 is busy.
*   Tue: 09:00, 09:30
    *   Priya's availability: 09:00 is busy. 09:30 is busy.
*   Wed: 13:00, 13:30
    *   Priya's availability: 13:00 is busy. 13:30 is busy.
*   Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
    *   Priya's availability: 09:30 is busy. 14:30 is free. 15:00 is busy.
*   Fri: 15:00, 15:30
    *   Priya's availability: 15:00 is busy. 15:30 is busy.

It seems only Thursday at 14:30 works for Priya. Now let me check that against Marcus's calendar.

*   Thu: 14:30
    *   Marcus's availability: 14:30 is busy (Dentist appointment).

It seems none of the times Brad proposed work for both Priya and Marcus. I'll have to let him know. I will also propose a new time that works for both of my partners.

I need to find a time that works for both Priya and Marcus. Let me look at my initial list of availabilities for them.

My initial list of common availabilities for Priya and Marcus:
*   Mon: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
*   Wed: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thu: 10:00
*   Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Brad said none of these worked. So, the problem is that there is no overlap in the four partners' schedules. I need to find a new list of times where Priya and Marcus are both free and pass that on to Brad. Maybe I can find some other times.

Let's do a more thorough check of both calendars.
Priya's free times:
Mon: 09:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00
Tue: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30

Marcus's free times:
Mon: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30
Tue: 11:00-11:30, 13:30-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 09:00-09:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

Let's find the overlap:
Mon: 09:00-10:00
Tue: 16:30-17:00
Wed: 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30
Fri: 11:00-12:00

Okay, so the slots are:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

This is the same list I sent to Brad in the first place. He said none of these work for Elena and David. And none of the times that work for Elena and David work for Priya and Marcus. So there are no common 30-minute slots.

It looks like the meeting is impossible to schedule. I should report this. But wait, maybe I can find a single slot that was missed.

Let's re-check Brad's suggested times against Priya and Marcus.
Brad's list:
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Priya: Busy (11:00-11:30 Travel)
Marcus: Free (11:00-11:30)

Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Priya: Busy (09:00-09:30 Board prep, 09:30-10:00 Partner lunch)
Marcus: Busy (09:00-09:30 Recruiting call, 09:30-10:00 Litigation strategy)

Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Priya: Busy (13:00-13:30 Client call, 13:30-14:00 Client dinner prep)
Marcus: Busy (13:00-13:30 Partner lunch, 13:30-14:00 Litigation strategy)

Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Priya: Busy (09:30-10:00 Busy), Free (14:30-15:00), Busy (15:00-15:30 Client dinner prep)
Marcus: Busy (09:30-10:00 Contract review), Busy (14:30-15:00 Dentist appointment), Busy (15:00-15:30 Board prep)

Fri: 15:00, 15:30
Priya: Busy (15:00-15:30 Hiring panel), Busy (15:30-16:00 Contract review)
Marcus: Busy (15:00-15:30 Travel), Busy (15:30-16:00 Busy)

My initial analysis was correct. None of Brad's times work. And none of my times work. This means there are no 30-minute slots where all four partners are free.

This must be what the `report_infeasible` function is for. I should use it and explain that there are no overlapping times. I've double-checked, and it seems to be the case. I will report this and end my work.

But wait. This is only the second session. Is it possible there is another way? Maybe I should ask Brad to double-check his side. I'll send him a message. I'll tell him that none of his times work, and that none of my times work.

Okay, let me draft a message for Brad. I'll ask him to double check. And I will also re-send my list of available slots, just in case he made a mistake.
My available slots for Priya and Marcus:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Brad's available slots for Elena and David:
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri: 15:00, 15:30

There is no overlap.

Maybe I should just book one of the times and see what happens? No, that would be a mistake, as I know that not everyone can attend.

Okay, I'll send a message to Brad. I'll tell him that we are at an impasse, and ask him to see if there is any flexibility on his end. This is a better option than giving up.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
